title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Muthoot Finance Limited
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 10, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹5.80 lakh (Rupees Five Lakh Eighty Thousand only) on Muthoot Finance Limited (the company) for non-compliance with certain provisions of ‘Reserve Bank of India Know Your Customer (KYC) Directions’.
